verdict.rationale: Runpod documents creating, starting, stopping and terminating Pods through its CLI, and creating, starting, stopping and querying them through the GraphQL API, with a REST API covering all compute resources. Pods are billed per second for compute and storage, so cost tracks running time. missing for 10: an explicit restart operation, documentation of what a stopped Pod still costs (storage) versus a terminated one, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the lifecycle API.
